question: How do they measure style transfer success?
title: Grammatical Error Correction and Style Transfer via Zero-shot Monolingual Translation
answer_short: They measure style transfer success by calculating the root mean square error (RMSE) between human evaluator scores and desired style direction values, assessing fluency, meaning preservation, and style direction accuracy.
answer_rationale: The document explains that style transfer success is evaluated using human evaluators who rate fluency, meaning preservation, and style direction. The RMSE metric is specifically used to quantify how accurately the model transfers style in the intended direction, with lower RMSE indicating better performance. This is detailed in Text 5, section 68-69, which describes the RMSE calculation and its interpretation.
